page.overview:
What is The Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask?

Every midnight, ??? emerges from the toilet of the asking for paper. It remains until 6:00 AM. Link can give it any item made of paper (such as Letters). After doing so, ??? disappears and a toilet flush is heard. ??? re-emerges with a that fell into the toilet. If this was done in subsequent appearances, no reward is given to the young hero.

Also known as: MM, Majora's Mask.
